weather_report:
This afternoon in Boston, the sun casts a gentle glow across the city, draping it in a tapestry of soft light. With temperatures rising near a comfortable 62 degrees, the atmosphere feels inviting yet breezy. The northwest wind carries a whisper of autumn, stirring the leaves that cling to their branches, heralding the changing season. As evening beckons, the skies will transition into a partly cloudy canvas, with the temperature dipping gracefully to around 42 degrees—an ideal setting for a cozy evening.

For today, the charm of the day lies in its simplicity and clarity, marking an exquisite opportunity to take a leisurely stroll along the Charles River. Perhaps you might indulge in a quiet moment with a book in one of the many parks, where the colors of fall are just beginning to unfurl. With such compelling weather, layering will serve you well; a light sweater or jacket will keep the chill at bay as twilight approaches. Embrace the tranquility of the season with a warm beverage in hand; there’s a certain magic to savoring the aroma of spiced cider against the backdrop of a fading day.
